assumptions.binary_endpoint: voluntary stop with at least one of three post-verdict decisions unused
assumptions.family_propensities: two-point +/- family shifts; independent reach, baseline, and treatment-effect signs
assumptions.pair_dependence: shared uniform with stated probability, else independent uniforms
assumptions.scope: C5 onset contrast only; no companion Holm power calculated

test: two-sided equal-family paired-difference Student-t, alpha=0.05; at least 15 contributing families
